description: This file defines a generic internal sealed class MemoryBatchContainer<TSerializer> implementing IBatchContainer and IOnDeserialized interfaces. It manages stream message batches, providing serialization/deserialization, and retrieval of contained events, with integration into Orleans stream messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: MemoryBatchContainer<TSerializer>
classes.description: A serializable container for stream messages that supports deserialization callbacks, containing message data, sequence tokens, and lazy-loaded payload.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of event data and their associated sequence tokens, cast to specified type.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports request context data from the payload into the current context, if available.
